title: ABOUT
body: Lumina Drops is where the ideas we can't stop thinking about become real. Each drop begins with an oddly specific, slightly unnecessary, completely irresistible spark. Where it goes from there? Let's find out, shall we?

facts.detail: Every drop has its moment - when it's gone, it's gone for good
No set format, no set theme. The idea decides where we take it
There's always another unreasonably specific idea waiting its turn
